simplify_graph: simplify a Jaxpr computation graph by recursively applying a graph simplifier to the graph and its subgraphs
detect: detect and replace activation patterns in a Jaxpr graph with synthetic primitives
group_linear_sequence: fold linear sequences of operations in a Jaxpr graph into synthetic linear primitives
group_fused_relu: identify and fuse linear operations followed by ReLU into a single FusedRelu primitive
activation_specs: generate synthetic primitive specs for common activation functions like ReLU, sigmoid, softmax, and softplus
